svg.title: gup — Providers
svg.desc: Providers view on Windows, scrolled down: providers not installed with the command that installs each, then the macOS and Linux providers greyed out as incompatible.
svg.text: gup v0.5.3 │ 14 detected │ 12 updates │ normal mode
Meant for another OS: gup neither detects nor updates them here.
– Mac App Store mas macOS only
– nvm (Node version manager) nvm macOS/Linux only
– xcodes (Xcode version manager) xcodes macOS only
